RAPID MEDICAL
Option 02 — Dark Theme
Generative Biotech

Dark Theme.
Generative Biotech

Animation approach: refined, slow, and data-inspired — subtle depth shifts, light parallax, and soft movement across the hero object, with motion used to enhance scientific depth rather than distract from content. This direction is darker, more focused, and more sculptural than the light theme.

The visual emphasis sits on one hero form, restrained typography, and clearly framed references. Color is concentrated into signals and gradients, while the overall layout stays calm and presentation-ready.

Visual Principles

Placed before references for client readability

Visual Principles

This direction combines clinical credibility with a more atmospheric, high-impact visual system. A dark field, one strong scientific form, and concentrated luminous color create a sense of innovation without turning the site into sci-fi theatre.

Design Language

Large clean type, spacious composition, quiet navigation, and a limited color range. Product visuals and content remain readable while the art direction delivers depth and distinctiveness through form, light, and motion.
